detail.longDescription: Stereogum: Meta Kicks Muse Off Their Social Handles To Launch New AI Agent. “At this point, I would guess that Muse the band are still way more famous than Muse the AI agent, but that didn’t stop Meta from taking the band Muse’s social media handles away from them. Now, they must deal with the humiliation of becoming @Museband on both Instagram and Facebook.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/15/stereogum-meta-kicks-muse-off-their-social-handles-to-launch-new-ai-agent/
